fullPassage: In honor of International Archaeology Day, the Institute of Archaeology is launching a Poetry and Slogan Competition for high school students. This event aims to raise awareness of our nation's rich archaeological and cultural heritage. Submission Criteria — Poem: 20 lines or less (must highlight positive aspects of the nation's archaeological and cultural heritage). Slogan: No more than 10 words (must focus on positive aspects of the nation's archaeological and cultural heritage). Prizes — The winner of each category (poem and slogan) will receive: An all-expenses-paid guided tour of Stonefire Caverns led by archaeologists. Deadline & Winner Announcement — Submission Deadline: October 20. Winners will be selected and contacted via email. How to Submit — Email submissions to: archheritagecontest@institute.org. Participants may submit either a poem or a slogan, not both. We look forward to your creative entries!
